summary.text: Barbara Fike is the Democratic candidate for Arizona House of Representatives District 28 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the July 21, 2026 Democratic primary.
A longtime English and social science teacher, she ran for the same district in 2024 and lost the general election.

paragraphs.text: Fike was born in Phoenix, Arizona, and earned a bachelor's degree from Northern Arizona University in 1975 and a graduate degree from the same university in 1978.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she taught English and social science in middle school, high school and community college for more than 40 years, retired from full-time teaching in the Deer Valley district, and currently teaches English classes at Glendale Community College North.
Ballotpedia says her career has also included work with the Arizona Department of Economic Security.
In the November 5, 2024 general election, Fike received 24.6 percent of the vote (51,780 votes), finishing behind Republican incumbents Beverly Pingerelli and David Livingston.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said public K-12 education is her passion, that curriculum should be developed by professional educators, and that she opposes vouchers.
